description: List the account's player profiles (GET /profile). 'Profiles' are player UI configs, not user accounts. Returns an array of {id, name, pullzone_name, is_default, updated_at, videos_count, feature_tags, colors, availableQualities}. The default profile ('Padrão') has is_default=true. Exclusive profiles (a single video's own customized player) are NOT listed. Use panda_get_profile for a profile's full settings. No pagination.
name: panda_list_profiles
title: List Profiles
